title: Personal Carbon Footprint Trend
dataSources: Carbon estimates (`carbon:estimate`), recycling weight (`recycling:weight`), food waste (`foodwaste:log`), repairs (`repair:event`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — carbon-footprint apps, home recycling scales, food-waste logs, and repair / reuse journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=carbon:estimate
| timechart span=1mon sum(kg_co2e) as footprint by category
description: Trends your estimated carbon footprint month by month, broken down by transport, food, energy, and goods.
value: A trended footprint turns good intentions into measurable progress and shows which changes actually move the needle.
implementation: Ingest carbon estimates into `index=personal`; trend footprint by category.
visualization: Stacked area chart of monthly carbon footprint by category.

references.title: UK Gov — greenhouse gas conversion factors

grandmaExplanation: It tracks your carbon footprint month by month, showing where your impact comes from.
